qualifier: meiotic as well as mitotic, including meiotic recombination and synapsis
name: Meiotic and mitotic chromosome cohesion, condensation and segregation
rationale: All members concern chromosome cohesion, condensation, centromere/kinetochore and segregation events in mitosis and especially meiosis (synapsis, recombination, chiasmata, female/male meiosis I), which the mitotic-exit, cytokinesis and nuclear-envelope confusables lack.

qualifier: end packaging and capping, replication, t-loop/D-loop processing
name: Telomere end capping, replication and t-loop processing
rationale: All members maintain telomere ends (packaging, positive capping, semi-conservative replication, t-circle and D-loop handling), whereas confusables emphasise negative capping, recombination-based maintenance and general fork/topology stability.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
name: Pyrimidine nucleotide and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members cover pyrimidine de novo synthesis, salvage and breakdown plus deoxyribonucleotide synthesis and turnover, distinguishing it from confusables centred on purine ribonucleotide synthesis, purine deoxynucleoside defects or NDP/NTP interconversion.

qualifier: metalloproteinase-mediated, with endopeptidase regulation
name: Metalloproteinase-driven collagen and elastin degradation and endopeptidase regulation
rationale: Members describe MMP activation and degradation of collagen and elastin with its positive and negative protease regulation, unlike confusables about fibrinolysis/contact activation or collagen and elastic fibre synthesis.

qualifier: ductal branching and epithelial lineages
name: Mammary gland ductal branching and epithelial lineage development
rationale: All members concern mammary development via epithelial lineages (stem, luminal, myoepithelial, alveolar), duct elongation, branching and thelarche, while confusables cover lactation/alveolar differentiation or prostate and reproductive tract development.

qualifier: to endogenous danger ligands with SIRP-restrained phagocytosis
name: Monocyte-macrophage inflammatory signaling to endogenous ligands and SIRP restraint
rationale: Members are myeloid/monocyte inflammatory programmes responding to endogenous signals (heme, oxidised LDL, endogenous TLR ligands) and SIRP-mediated restraint of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, unlike confusables centred on LPS/TLR2/4 detection, Fc receptor effector functions or antigen presentation.

qualifier: heterochromatin foci, Polycomb silencing and secretory phenotype
name: Cellular senescence with heterochromatin foci and secretory phenotype
rationale: All members concern induction and regulation of oncogene-, stress- and replication-induced senescence, distinguished by SAHF/Polycomb chromatin silencing and the SASP, whereas confusables focus on p53 apoptosis, UV response or cancer evasion of senescence.

qualifier: transferrin endocytosis and recycling
name: Transferrin-mediated iron uptake and endosomal recycling
rationale: All three members concern the transferrin cycle and endosomal iron export via SLC11A2, whereas confusables cover heme scavenging, plasma-membrane iron import, copper/manganese handling or systemic iron homeostasis.

qualifier: oxidative demethylation and N-acetylation, including plant-derived compounds
name: Xenobiotic and phytochemical oxidative demethylation and N-acetylation
rationale: Members describe xenobiotic detoxification via CYP1A2 oxidation/demethylation and acetylation of aromatic amines and plant compounds (alkaloids, terpenoids, phenylpropanoids), unlike confusables built on sulfonation, methylation, FMO or CYP2E1 reactions.

qualifier: Sema4D and RND1 in cell migration
name: Semaphorin 4D-plexin signaling via RND1 in cell migration
rationale: All members are semaphorin-plexin signaling, specifically Sema4D-driven growth-cone collapse and inhibition of attachment/migration with RND1, distinguishing it from Sema3A axon repulsion, RND2/3 or G12/13-Rho confusables.

qualifier: metanephric mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition
name: Metanephric mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition and nephron tubule differentiation
rationale: All three members concern epithelial differentiation of metanephric mesenchyme into nephron tubule cells, whereas confusables cover comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis, ureteric bud and duct development or pronephros patterning.

qualifier: joint T and B cell, including B cell differentiation and proliferation
name: T and B lymphocyte development, differentiation and activation
rationale: Members span both thymocyte/T cell differentiation and B cell differentiation and proliferation, while each confusable is restricted to early B lineage commitment, T cell activation subsets, or mature B cell programmes.

qualifier: NER gap filling and error-free Pol eta translesion synthesis
name: NER gap-filling synthesis and error-free Pol eta translesion synthesis
rationale: Members concern repair DNA synthesis filling NER gaps and error-free bypass by polymerase eta, distinguishing it from confusables on NER damage recognition/incision, base excision repair or error-prone translesion polymerases.

core: Cell-matrix adhesion signaling to the actin cytoskeleton
qualifier: fibronectin, integrin and syndecan; stress fibers and fibroblast migration
name: Fibronectin-integrin-syndecan adhesion driving stress fibers and fibroblast migration
rationale: Members link fibronectin matrix, integrin synthesis and syndecan interactions to SRF-dependent cytoskeletal remodeling, stress fibers and fibroblast migration, unlike confusables centred on focal adhesion assembly, ROCK/PAK, MET-PTK2 or invadopodia.

qualifier: kinesin- and Miro-driven transport of mitochondria and vesicles
name: Kinesin- and Miro-driven microtubule transport of mitochondria and vesicles
rationale: Members describe motor-driven transport of mitochondria (RHOT1/2), dense-core and synaptic vesicles, receptors and endolysosomes along microtubules in axons and dendrites, distinguishing it from tubulin modification/severing, ER network or clathrin endocytosis confusables.

qualifier: to mitogens, UV and nitric oxide
name: AP-1 immediate-early gene response to mitogens, UV and nitric oxide
rationale: Members are immediate-early AP-1/FOSL/NR4A transcriptional programmes induced by growth factors, phorbol ester, KRAS/PI3K, UV and reactive nitrogen, distinguishing it from confusables on MAPK negative feedback or TAK1-JNK/p38 kinase activation.

qualifier: ribbon disassembly, reassembly and pericentriolar positioning
name: Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and pericentriolar positioning
rationale: All members concern Golgi ribbon structure and positioning (disassembly, reassembly, pericentriolar stacking, kinectin-mediated localization), unlike confusables about intra-Golgi traffic, vesicle budding or other Rho GTPase effectors.

core: Neutral amino acid and thyroid hormone transport
qualifier: with iodide uptake for thyroid hormone generation
name: Neutral amino acid, thyroid hormone and iodide transport
rationale: Members combine neutral amino acid transporters (which also carry thyroid hormone) with thyroid hormone transport, iodide uptake and hormone generation, distinguishing it from confusables on cationic amino acid, polyamine or inositol transport.

qualifier: AIM2 and NLRC4 (IPAF) inflammasomes
name: AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasome-driven pyroptosis
rationale: Members concern AIM2 and IPAF/NLRC4 inflammasomes and gasdermin pyroptotic cell death, distinguishing it from NLRP1/NLRP3 IL-1 processing and caspase-4/5 non-canonical inflammasome confusables.

qualifier: Rho GTPase-WASP/WAVE driving lamellipodium assembly
name: WASP/WAVE-Arp2/3 actin nucleation driving lamellipodium assembly
rationale: All three members describe Rho GTPase activation of WASP/WAVE to promote Arp2/3 nucleation and lamellipodia, distinguishing it from confusables on general leading-edge polymerization, Rac GTPase cycles or Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis.

qualifier: including maternal mRNA clearance at the maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay and maternal mRNA clearance
rationale: Members concern poly(A) shortening, deadenylation-dependent decay and P-body assembly, including M- and Z-decay of maternal mRNAs, unlike confusables on nuclear RNA processing/surveillance, RBP- and miRNA-mediated decay or MZT chromatin and piRNA.

qualifier: intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and metanephric mesenchyme induction
name: Early kidney development from intermediate mesoderm to nephron induction
rationale: Members span intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and pronephros formation, metanephric mesenchyme maintenance/differentiation, MET, renal vesicle and ureteric bud elongation, whereas confusables cover later S-shaped body morphogenesis or kidney growth control.

qualifier: brown/beige differentiation and cold-induced thermogenesis
name: Brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and cold-induced thermogenesis
rationale: Members concern brown/beige fat differentiation, cold and diet-induced thermogenesis, PGC-1alpha activation and fatty acid cycling, distinguishing it from white adipogenesis, lipolysis/lipid droplet and lipogenic transcription confusables.

qualifier: lipase-driven triglyceride and phospholipid hydrolysis
name: Plasma lipoprotein remodeling, lipase-driven triglyceride hydrolysis and clearance
rationale: Members describe intravascular remodeling and clearance of chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL particles with LPL/hepatic lipase activation, unlike confusables centred on intestinal absorption, lipoprotein assembly or LXR transcription.

qualifier: glial fate, proliferation and reactive gliosis
name: Glial differentiation, proliferation, myelination and reactive gliosis
rationale: Members concern oligodendrocyte, astrocyte and Schwann cell specification, proliferation and differentiation, CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance and astrocyte activation, distinguishing it from axon regeneration and node-of-Ranvier confusables.
